architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The frontend is the mobile application developed with Flutter, responsible for the user interface, navigation, and interaction with the user.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The backend is the software responsible for processing user requests, business logic, and data persistence.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Manages the application state and communication with the user interface using Bloc/Cubit.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the business logic, with use cases, entities, and repositories defined as interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer (Frontend)
architectural_units.description: Handles data access, including backend calls, data transformation, and concrete repository implementation.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, domain models, and repository interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Includes system use cases that orchestrate business logic and define operation flows.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer (Backend)
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the exterior, including Django HTTP views, ORM repositories, and external service adapters.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the cross-platform development of the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used for building the REST API.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service for artificial intelligence capabilities like Gemini or ChatGPT.

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for the Cintia functionality.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: AI service provider used for the Cintia functionality.

architectural_units.name: REST API
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used between frontend and backend.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Protocol used for the REST API communication.

The frontend is the software responsible for processing user requests, business logic, and data persistence. [...] The communication between the front-end and the back-end is performed through a REST API, using JSON format messages for both requests and responses.
The back-end integrates several external services through the back-end, such as artificial intelligence services (Gemini or ChatGPT).
The persistence of data is performed through a MySQL relational database, managed through the Django ORM.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The system interaction is performed through a mobile application (frontend) that makes requests to a server (backend).

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The backend follows the Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters) pattern, which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture
patterns.description: The frontend follows an architecture based on the principles of Clean Architecture, applied strictly.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to system configuration.
